name: Buka
reason: Wikivoyage Bougainville names Buka as the hub town with market, tourist office and the Buka Passage boat trips, which it calls a key visitor attraction; a harbour town a guide recommends as a stop.

name: Lorengau
reason: Wikivoyage has its own Lorengau page and papuanewguinea.travel covers it as Manus Province's capital and gateway; a regional hub town earns a low-rank spot, though its sights are thin (market, WWII relics around the harbour).

name: Malagan Carvings
reason: A cultural tradition and ceremonies, not a place a visitor can walk up to at any time; ceremonies are events and there is no fixed venue. Any real venue (carving village, workshop) should be judged on its own.

name: Momote Memorial Park
reason: Single source is a hotel listing on the tourism page; a minor WWII memorial with no guide naming it as a stop and no half-hour activity.

name: Seeadler Harbour
reason: For: Wikivoyage Lorengau and papuanewguinea.travel both name it, and WWII relics can still be seen around it. Against: it is a water body with no defined visitor spot or activity, largely the setting of Lorengau; keep only if the owner wants it as a relics or boat-trip stop, otherwise fold into Lorengau.
